basic_info.description: Luxury Parkside Retreat! This stunning 3-side detached corner home in SF's desirable neighborhood has been completely renovated from the ground up. With 5 spacious bedrooms 4.5 baths appr. 2,569 sqft of refined living space, it offers the perfect blend of luxury & functionality. The upper level boasts light-filled open-concept living, dining & stylish kitchen w/ custom cabinetry & premium appliances and 3 bedrooms 2 full baths including master suite. The lower level features two additional bedrooms each has its own bath, family room w/ wet bar & recreation room with washer/dryer closet & half bath, plus garage w/220V EV charger. The best of this home is its prime location, across from the park offering breathtaking views from nearly every room, with nearby playgrounds, tennis courts, it's perfect for families. It's also within a short distance to West Portal, Lakeshore, StonesTown shops & restaurants, and the easy access to highways. This property also presents a unique opportunity for savvy investors with the potential to rent out individual suites to generate extra income. Bike distance to SFSU, ample street parking & proximity to public transportation, this home offers the perfect blend of luxury, convenience & investment potential. Don't miss out this incredible opportunity!
